name: The Animal Half
summary:
The Animal Half is a Japanese PC game released in 2005 by developer and publisher Doll. The game features anime-style characters and is presumed to be a visual novel, based on its interface and presentation. It was released exclusively in Japan and is available only in Japanese.

The title suggests a thematic focus on characters with animal traits, a common motif in Japanese doujin (indie) games. While detailed gameplay and story elements remain undocumented, the game appears to center around narrative-driven interactions typical of the visual novel genre.
